title: RC 高通：电容挡住直流，放过交流
summary: 10 nF + 15 kΩ，输入带 2 V 直流偏置：看偏置被电容挡住，测低频的增益和相位，再扫频找出截止频率。
concepts: 叠加定理：直流和交流分开算 superposition of DC and AC
description: 信号发生器（正弦波，偏置 2 V）→ C1（10 nF）→ VOUT → R1（15 kΩ）→ GND。和低通相比，只是 R 和 C 对调。直流和交流分开看：直流被电容挡住，交流按 H = jωRC/(1 + jωRC) 通过。

cards.title: 2 V 偏置去哪了？
text: 信号发生器：**正弦波、`1 kHz`、幅度 `1 V`、偏置 `2 V`**。CH1 的波形整体抬高了 2 V，在 1 V 到 3 V 之间摆动。
看 CH2：它的中心线在哪里？那 2 V 去哪了？

cards.title: 电容是一扇只让变化通过的门
text: - 电容的两块极板之间是绝缘的。**直流**进去，充满以后就再也没有电流——2 V 偏置全“存”在电容上，电阻上一点也分不到。
- **交流**一直在变，电容一直在充、放电，变化就传过去了。所以 VOUT 只剩以 0 V 为中心的那一部分。
![](fig:dcblock)
- 交流部分也看频率：频率越低，电容越像断开，传过去的越少。所以这是**高通**。截止频率的公式和低通一样：
动手之前先把它算出来，再看下图：高通的曲线正好和低通左右相反。
![](fig:hp)

cards.title: 先量直流，再扫频
text: - **万用表**红表笔点 VOUT（第 `10` 列），黑表笔在 GND：读平均电压（或者看示波器 CH2 的「平均」）。
- 频率调到 **`106 Hz`**：读幅度比（CH2 的 Vpp ÷ CH1 的 Vpp）和 **CH2 相对 CH1 的相位差**。
- 最后**扫频**：慢慢往上调，找到 CH2 的 Vpp 正好是 CH1 的 0.707 倍的那个频率。

cards.title: 带走
text: - **隔直电容**：直流过不去，交流过得去。放大器之间常用它把上一级的偏置挡掉。
- **高通**：$f_c$ 以下越来越小，而且输出**超前**输入；$f_c$ 以上几乎原样通过。同样的 R、C，低通和高通的 $f_c$ 一样。
- 坑：µF 级的隔直电容多是**铝电解电容**，有正负。+ 脚要接直流电位高的一侧（这里是 2 V 的 VIN 一侧）。接反会漏电、发热，时间长了会坏。仿真里的电容不分正负。

caption.text: 输入（CH1）以 2 V 为中心摆动；过了电容，输出（CH2）以 0 V 为中心——直流被挡住了。

i18n.en: The input (CH1) swings around 2 V; past the capacitor the output (CH2) swings around 0 V — the DC is blocked.

caption.text: 同样的 R、C：高通（实线）和低通（虚线）在 f_c 处交叉，两边正好相反。

i18n.en: Same R and C: the high-pass (solid) and the low-pass (dashed) cross at f_c and mirror each other.

en.title: RC high-pass: the capacitor blocks DC and passes AC
en.summary: 10 nF + 15 kΩ with a 2 V DC offset on the input: watch the capacitor block the offset, measure gain and phase at a low frequency, and sweep for the cutoff frequency.
en.description: Generator (sine, 2 V offset) → C1 (10 nF) → VOUT → R1 (15 kΩ) → GND — the low-pass with R and C swapped. Look at DC and AC separately: the capacitor blocks the DC, and the AC passes as H = jωRC/(1 + jωRC).
compare: - **The DC part (2 V)**: in steady state no current flows in R1 and the DC part of VOUT is 0; the capacitor quietly "stores" the 2 V. CH1 averages ≈ 2 V, CH2 averages ≈ 0. That's the **coupling (DC-blocking) capacitor** used between amplifier stages.
- **The AC part**: H(jω) = jωRC/(1 + jωRC), |H| = (f/fc)/√(1 + (f/fc)²), ∠H = 90° − arctan(f/fc), fc = 1/(2π × 15 kΩ × 10 nF) ≈ 1061 Hz.
- **106 Hz (fc/10)**: |H| ≈ 0.0995 (−20 dB), phase **+84.3°** — low frequencies are almost blocked, and what's left leads by nearly 90° (current in a capacitive branch leads the voltage).
- **10.6 kHz (10fc)**: |H| ≈ 0.995, phase +5.7° — at high frequency the capacitor is almost a wire.

measurements.ask: Multimeter DC range (or the scope's average): VOUT to GND, the average
measurements.explain: The capacitor is open at DC, so in steady state R1 carries no DC: VOUT has no DC part and the whole 2 V sits on the capacitor. That is a DC-blocking (coupling) capacitor.

measurements.ask: f = 106 Hz: amplitude ratio VOUT/VIN (CH2 Vpp ÷ CH1 Vpp)
f = 106 Hz: phase of VOUT relative to VIN (leading is positive)
measurements.explain: ∠H = 90° − arctan(0.1) ≈ +84.3°: what little gets through at low frequency leads by nearly 90°.

measurements.ask: Sweep: the frequency fc where the amplitude ratio is 0.707
measurements.explain: fc = 1/(2π × 15 kΩ × 10 nF) ≈ 1061 Hz, the same as the low-pass; the phase there is +45°.

hints: Capacitor in series first, resistor from VOUT to GND.
The DC offset cannot get through a capacitor: in steady state, does any DC flow in R1?
fc = 1/(2πRC) ≈ 1061 Hz; at fc expect 0.707 and +45°.
tests: DC blocked: VIN carries the offset, VOUT does not
fc/10 = 106 Hz: sensible gain and phase
fc = 1061 Hz: sensible gain and phase

cards.title: Where did the 2 V go?
text: This time the **capacitor** (`10 nF`) comes first: **`b3`**–**`b10`**; the **resistor** (`15 kΩ`) after it: **`c10`**–**`tn10`**. Compared with the low-pass, the two parts have simply swapped places.
Generator: **sine, `1 kHz`, amplitude `1 V`, offset `2 V`**. The whole CH1 trace is lifted by 2 V and swings between 1 V and 3 V.
Look at CH2: where is its centre line? Where did the 2 V go?

cards.title: A capacitor is a door that only lets change through
text: - The two plates of a capacitor are insulated from each other. Put **DC** in and, once it has charged, no more current flows — the whole 2 V offset sits on the capacitor, and the resistor gets none of it.
- **AC** keeps changing, so the capacitor keeps charging and discharging, and the change gets through. VOUT keeps only the part centred on 0 V.
![](fig:dcblock)

- The AC part depends on frequency too: the lower the frequency, the more the capacitor looks open and the less gets through. So this is a **high-pass**. Its cutoff frequency has the same formula as the low-pass:
Work it out before you start, then look at the curve below: the high-pass is the low-pass mirrored.
![](fig:hp)

cards.title: DC first, then sweep
text: - **Multimeter** red probe on VOUT (column `10`), black on GND: read the average voltage (or CH2's "Vavg" on the scope).
- Set **`106 Hz`**: read the amplitude ratio (CH2 Vpp ÷ CH1 Vpp) and the **phase of CH2 vs CH1**.
- Finally **sweep**: turn the frequency up slowly and find where CH2's Vpp is exactly 0.707 × CH1's.

cards.title: Take away
text: - **DC-blocking (coupling) capacitor**: DC can't get through, AC can. Amplifier stages use it to keep one stage's bias out of the next.
- **High-pass**: below $f_c$ the output gets smaller and **leads** the input; above $f_c$ it passes almost unchanged. With the same R and C, low-pass and high-pass share one $f_c$.

- Pitfall: µF coupling capacitors are mostly **aluminium electrolytics**, which have a + and a − lead. The + lead goes to the side at the higher DC voltage (here the 2 V VIN side). Reversed, they leak, heat up and eventually fail. The simulated capacitor has no polarity.

tests.name: 隔直：VIN 带直流偏置，VOUT 没有

compare: - **直流部分（2 V）**：稳态下 R1 里没有电流，VOUT 的直流分量 = 0，电容两端稳稳地“存”着 2 V。CH1 的平均值 ≈ 2 V，CH2 的平均值 ≈ 0。这就是放大器之间常用的**隔直（耦合）电容**。
- **交流部分**：H(jω) = jωRC/(1 + jωRC)，|H| = (f/fc)/√(1 + (f/fc)²)，∠H = 90° − arctan(f/fc)，fc = 1/(2π × 15 kΩ × 10 nF) ≈ 1061 Hz。
- **106 Hz（fc/10）**：|H| ≈ 0.0995（−20 dB），相位 **+84.3°**——低频几乎被挡住，剩下的一点还超前将近 90°（电容支路里电流超前电压）。

measurements.ask: 万用表直流档（或示波器的平均值）：VOUT 对 GND 的平均电压
measurements.explain: 电容对直流开路，稳态下 R1 没有直流电流：VOUT 的直流分量是 0，2 V 全“存”在电容上。这就是隔直（耦合）电容。

measurements.ask: f = 106 Hz：幅度比 VOUT/VIN（CH2 的 Vpp ÷ CH1 的 Vpp）
f = 106 Hz：VOUT 相对 VIN 的相位差（超前为正）
measurements.explain: ∠H = 90° − arctan(0.1) ≈ +84.3°：低频时剩下的一点输出超前将近 90°。

measurements.ask: 扫频：幅度比降到 0.707 的频率 fc
measurements.explain: fc = 1/(2π × 15 kΩ × 10 nF) ≈ 1061 Hz，和低通一样；在 fc 处相位是 +45°。

hints: 电容串联在前，电阻从 VOUT 接到 GND。
直流偏置过不了电容：稳态下 R1 里有没有直流电流？
fc = 1/(2πRC) ≈ 1061 Hz；在 fc 处应看到 0.707 和 +45°。
